paragraphs.text: The Soldevi Adnates were a cult of machine worshipers, active in Soldev during the Ice Age of Dominaria . Their name implies that they aspired to be compleated .

With the help of a possessed Jaya Ballard , they woke the Phyrexian War Beasts that Arcum Dagsson had excavated at Koilos . These, in turn, took control of the Soldevi Steam Beasts , that Dagson had designed after their blueprints. This heralded the destruction of Soldev.
